Normal: With one core busy the processor stayed at or just under its base clock instead of speeding up. It is holding back a little, usually for heat.
If the PC is a few years old, cleaning the fan and heatsink is the first thing to try.
Bad: With one core busy the processor ran well below its base clock, so it is slowing itself down and the PC feels slower than it should.
The usual cause is heat: clean the fan and heatsink, and on a laptop several years old replace the thermal paste.
Also check the charger is the wattage the laptop needs. A weaker one can hold the processor back on purpose.
Check the Windows power mode is not set to battery saver or best power efficiency.

rules.forecast: A processor that throttles under light load will throttle harder in summer and under real work.

Normal: Somewhat below what this class of drive should manage. First check the obvious: was anything else busy (a backup, a game updating, an antivirus scan) while the test ran? Re-run it on an idle PC before drawing conclusions.
A drive with less than 10-15% free space slows down measurably. Free some space and measure again.

SATA drives: a loose or poor cable can silently drop the link to a slower mode. NVMe drives: check the slot is the one the manual says is full-speed — motherboards often share lanes between the second M.2 slot and the graphics card.
Bad: Well under what this class of drive should manage. BACK UP anything important on it first — a drive that has become slow can be a drive that is failing, and the Storage checks in this report are worth reading alongside this one.

Rule out the easy causes before replacing anything: another program using the disk during the test, less than 10% free space, an almost-full SSD without TRIM, or power settings holding the drive back.
If this is an external drive, the enclosure and cable are the usual culprits rather than the drive. Try a different cable and a port directly on the motherboard.

rules.forecast: Speed on its own rarely predicts failure, but a drive that gets slower scan after scan while its error counters move is a drive to replace before it decides for you.
